items.text: AI/LLM Engineer. Forward Deployed Engineer. Netcracker Technology. Building and running on-premise LLM infrastructure for internal engineering platforms.. SGLang, vLLM, Kimi-K2.6, GPT-OSS, RAG, RAGAS, Agents, APM
